about_the_game:
Explore a peaceful park filled with mysteries, art and wild landscapes. Repair what has been broken, unlock the exit and learn the truth about what happened in The Valley.

A Living Art Park
Wander through a world where wild landscapes blend with monumental art. Every corner invites you to discover something new.

A Different Way to Play
There are no quests, mini-maps, or combat. UI is minimal so you can explore at your own pace. All progress comes from your own curiosity and careful observation.

Relaxing Yet Rewarding
Enjoy a peaceful journey at your own pace. Most puzzles are gentle and encourage you to observe and think, but the park hides many deeper secrets for keen-eyed explorers seeking a thougher challenge.

Repair and Reveal
Restore mechanisms to make your way forward. Each step brings you closer to unlocking the path out of the valley and learning the truth about your journey.

A Mystery with Surprises
The story ends with a twist that lets you see the park in a whole new light and discover the truth about its last inhabitants.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 ou 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT

short_description: Step into a fantastic landscape where art and nature hide many secrets. Solve puzzles and find hidden paths as you search for the truth and why the park can’t let you leave. No enemies, no waypoints, no hand-holding: curiosity is your only fuel for piecing the park many mysteries.
